# AL1307: Avoid fire-and-forget task discard

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/ANcpLua.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Warning |
| Category | `Reliability` |
| Code fix | No |
| Analyzer | `Al1307FireAndForgetTaskAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

Discarding a Task with _ = causes fire-and-forget behavior where exceptions are silently lost. Await the task, store it for later observation, or add a continuation with error handling.
